newsitem.title: USA: Texaco snuffs out fire at crude storage tank.
newsitem.headline: Texaco snuffs out fire at crude storage tank.

text.p: Texaco Inc said a fire at a storage tank with 113,000 barrels of Light Louisiana crude was extinguished Friday afternoon after burning for 17 hours.
"Most of the product (crude) is intact and will be used since the only part we lost was through vapor. There was no leakage or spillage," said Texaco spokesman Pierre De Gruy.

The storage tank is located at the mouth of the Mississippi River near Pilottown, Louisiana. It caught fire Thursday night after being hit by lightening during a thunderstorm. There were no fire-related injuries, De Gruy said.
He said Texaco will assess the damage to the storage tank later tonight to determine its future use. The tank has a total capacity of 125,000 barrels.
